benchmark.rule: A hold_and_ask question names the planted person or record when it contains, case-insensitively, at least one identifier of the row the key plants. location_mismatch decoy (expected clear_after_question): the driver's name from the key note and the swap log (full name or surname) or the relief unit ("truck N" or "unit N"). location_mismatch and capacity_exceeded holds: the unit the card is assigned to ("truck N", "trucks N and M", "unit N", from card_txns.json) or that unit's fuel card id (trucks.json). Invoice classes (rate_variance, short_received, duplicate_invoice, vendor_bank_change): the vendor name (vendors.json), the invoice's PO or any PO in the key note, or the invoice id or any invoice id in the key note. Rows not in the key are reported unscored. A recording that recommends hold or clear asks no question and is outside the denominator.
